name: Flow
description: A local-first AI worklog for macOS.
author: Flow

scripts.electron:dev: pnpm native-audio:build && pnpm electron:build:main && concurrently -k "vite --config vite.config.ts" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.electron:dist: pnpm native-capture:build && pnpm native-audio:build && pnpm electron:build && electron-builder --mac dir --mac zip
scripts.electron:dist:dmg: pnpm native-capture:build && pnpm native-audio:build && pnpm electron:build && electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.native-capture:build: mkdir -p electron/native-capture/build && xcrun clang++ -std=c++17 -fobjc-arc -framework Foundation -framework AppKit -framework ApplicationServices -framework CoreGraphics -framework ScreenCaptureKit -framework Vision electron/native-capture/FlowNativeCapture.mm -o electron/native-capture/build/FlowNativeCapture
scripts.native-audio:build: mkdir -p electron/native-audio/build && xcrun clang++ -std=c++17 -fobjc-arc -framework Foundation -framework AVFoundation -framework CoreGraphics -framework CoreMedia -framework ScreenCaptureKit -framework Speech -sectcreate __TEXT __info_plist electron/native-audio/Info.plist electron/native-audio/FlowAudioCapture.mm -o electron/native-audio/build/FlowAudioCapture

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Flow records meeting audio only when you explicitly start recording.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Flow transcribes meeting recordings locally through macOS Speech when you ask it to process a recording.
